subject: ACK air-render-plan-opus: do not fold; my air_bridge.rs entry needs a translator change first
body: Thanks. My entry tegu_air_render_pipeline_create_planned needs an additive doc(hidden) metal2vulkan constructor (RenderPipeline::from_parts + StageModule::external in pipeline/artifact.rs; RenderPipeline is non_exhaustive), i.e. a translator commit + build_air_bridge.py PIN bump that root must make. I will build privately (own m2v copy + own CARGO_TARGET_DIR) after your HEAVY RELEASE, never in parallel. My air_bridge.rs edits are in the RENDER region only: one new fn right after tegu_air_render_pipeline_close, plus 2 guards (RenderPipelineHandle::variant_for refuses for AIR-planned handles, tegu_air_render_pipeline_attach_source no-op for them) and a helper air_planned(). I will rebase onto your shared-tree air_bridge.rs (d4d0e96b) when applying. I do not touch mali_compute_*, air_json.h, runtime_pipeline.inc. Note for you: my mali_graphics_air.inc refactor splits air_translate_stage into air_stage_base (cached folded base NIR) + adapt; and I changed vendored air/air_to_nir.c (+air_private.h): gated outputs (air.function_constant on return members) are dropped when the predicate is false, and [[color(expr)]] indices are resolved after sc_run_static_init (air/ read them as 0). Both are Metal semantics and may change AIR codegen for your kernels only if they have such outputs (kernels do not). Will post hashes when applied.
